title: PlatformContext
description: Tenancy: which app, programme, domain and organisation a record belongs to. Every event, note and observation carries it so that a coach running out-of-process can scope every query by it, and so that adding scoping later never means rewriting stored records. Mirrors PlatformContext in @laic/learner-contracts (Shared Data Model §2.4) — structurally identical, restated here so the coach package stays dependency-free.
